resources.string: Used to inspect visible screen labels and perform user-requested UI actions such as opening apps, tapping buttons, typing, and scrolling. It never collects passwords or private credentials.

Privacy & Safety Principles:
1. The microphone is never active unless you explicitly tap to speak.
2. Screen sharing starts only after Android's official consent prompt and displays a clear live indicator.
3. Passwords, PINs, OTPs, biometric prompts, and payment confirmations are never bypassed or auto-filled.
4. When connected to Google Gemini, prompts are sent over encrypted HTTPS using your API key and quota.
